sentences.sentence: In addition, plants have also evolved an adaptive inducible resistance mechanism in response to pathogen invasion.
sentences.translation: 同时，植物还形成了一套适应性更广的可诱导的抗病机制。

sentences.sentence: Objective To study the expression of inducible nitric oxide synthase in lung carcinoma and its relation with clinical parameters and tumor angiogenesis.
sentences.translation: 目的：研究人体肺癌组织诱导型一氧化氮合酶的表达及其与临床参数和肿瘤血管生成的关系。

sentences.sentence: To examine the effect of simulated weightlessness on inducible HSP70 expression in the heart and vessel tissues of rats, a tail suspension rat model was used to simulate weightlessness.
sentences.translation: 为研究模拟失重是否可引起大鼠心肌与血管组织HSP70的诱导表达发生改变，用尾部悬吊大鼠模型模拟失重，以研究失重对生理的影响。

sentences.sentence: Botany The hood-shaped sepal or corolla of some flowers.
sentences.translation: 盔状花冠（或花萼）：某些花朵盔状的花萼或花冠。

sentences.sentence: A flower is made up of four parts:the sepal, petal, stamen and pistil.
sentences.translation: 一朵花由四部分组成：花萼，花瓣，雄蕊和雌蕊。

sentences.sentence: Leave away the sepal and crash the petal parts. Preheat the oven to 175C/350F.
sentences.translation: 将干燥玫瑰花去掉花萼，以手捏碎花瓣部份。烤箱预热至175C/350F。

sentences.sentence: ...snippets of popular classical music.
sentences.translation: …流行古典音乐的片段。

phrases.translation: 找出一一对应的关系；使…与…发生关系

sentences.sentence: Attempts to correlate specific language functions with particular parts of the brain have not advanced very far.
sentences.translation: 试图把特定的语言功能和大脑特定区域相联系的努力还没有取得很大进展。

phrases.translation: n. 蜣螂；金龟子科；甲虫

sentences.sentence: He studied the Namib beetle, an ingenious species that lives in one of the driest places on earth.
sentences.translation: 他研究了纳米布甲虫，这是一种机灵的物种，生活在世界上最干燥的地方之一。

sentences.sentence: With half an inch of rain per year, the beetle can only survive by consuming the dew it collects on the hydrophilic skin of its back in the early mornings.
sentences.translation: 它的生活地每年只有半英尺的降雨量，这种甲虫可以通过使用它背部具吸水性的皮肤在早晨收集的水露存活下来。

sentences.sentence: While other bugs may change color due to external circumstances like temperature, the Panamanian tortoise beetle is one of the few creatures known to control its own color changing.
sentences.translation: 据了解，其他小虫可能是随着外部环境（如：气温）的变化而变色的，但巴拿马龟甲虫是可以控制自身颜色变化的少数动物之一。

sentences.sentence: Straight edge: The miracle fruit (Synsepalum dulcificum), native to West Africa, contains a glycoprotein called miraculin that binds to taste receptors on the tongue and makes sour foods taste sweet.
sentences.translation: 神秘果：一种原产于西非的水果，内含一种叫神秘果蛋白的糖蛋白。 神秘果蛋白结合在味蕾上以后，吃酸的东西也感到是甜的。

sentences.sentence: What makes the fruit strange and miraculous, is miraculin (a sugar substitute), which is found in large quantities in the fruit, combined with a glycoprotein.
sentences.translation: 神秘果之所以奇妙神奇，是因水果中含有大量的神秘果素（代糖），合成一种糖蛋白（变味糖蛋白）。

心脏性猝死；突然心脏死
心律失常；心律不整；心律紊乱

sentences.translation: 心脏手术

phrases.translation: 胶质细胞；神经胶质细胞

sentences.sentence: The glial tissue is where the largest percentage of brain tumors begin.
sentences.translation: 胶质组织是绝大多数脑部肿瘤的起源。

sentences.sentence: Cancerous glial tumors generally spread in the brain the way roots spread from a plant.
sentences.translation: 恶性胶质瘤通常会像从植物伸展出来的根须一样在脑内扩散。

sentences.sentence: The aura in migraine has been shown to be caused primarily bycortical spreading depression (CSD), a progression of depolarizationin neurons and glial cells that spreads slowly across the cortex.
sentences.translation: 偏头痛的先兆主要由皮层传播抑制引起（CSD），CSD是一种在神经元和胶质细胞缓慢穿过皮质的去极化进程。

phrases.translation: 植物性神经系统，自主神经系统

sentences.sentence: Concepts such as autonomic computing will have a key role in cloud storage architectures in the future.
sentences.translation: 在未来，诸如自主计算这样的概念将在云存储架构中起到关键的作用。

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 297 单元

hopeless
音标：英 /'həʊpləs/  美 /ˈhoʊpləs/
adj. 没有希望的,不可救药
例句：We tried to stop the flames from spreading, but we knew it was hopeless.
我们试图阻止火势蔓延，但我们知道这是不可能的。
例句：Getting your work published often seems a hopeless task .
想让自己的作品出版似乎总是徒劳的。
例句：I kept on struggling forward, even though I knew it was hopeless .
虽然知道无望，我还是奋力挣扎向前。

interchangeable
音标：英 /ɪntə'tʃeɪn(d)ʒəbl/  美 /,ɪntɚ'tʃendʒəbl/
adj. 可互换的,可交换的
短语：interchangeable parts — 通用件；互换部件
例句：These two words are almost interchangeable.
这两个单词几乎可以互换使用。
例句：a camera with interchangeable lenses
可换镜头的照相机

bizarre
音标：英 /bɪ'zɑː/  美 /bɪ'zɑr/
adj. 奇异的(指态度,容貌,款式等)
例句：a bizarre coincidence
奇怪的巧合

laundry
音标：英 /'lɔːndrɪ/  美 /'lɔndri/
n. 洗衣店, 要洗的衣服
短语：laundry detergent — 洗衣粉；洗衣精

短语：laundry bag — 洗衣袋
短语：laundry room — 洗衣房；洗衣间；洗衣室
短语：laundry list — 细目清单
短语：dirty laundry — 脏衣服
短语：do the laundry — 洗衣服；做洗衣服的活
短语：laundry basket — 洗衣篮
短语：laundry soap — [化]洗涤皂
例句：She did the laundry (= washed the clothes etc ) and hung it out to dry.
她洗了衣服，然后挂出去晾干。
例句：Ben was folding laundry.
本正在叠洗好的衣服。

definitive
音标：英 /dɪ'fɪnɪtɪv/  美 /dɪ'fɪnətɪv/

puncture
音标：英 /'pʌŋ(k)tʃə/  美 /'pʌŋktʃɚ/
n. 小孔
v. 刺破
短语：lumbar puncture — [医]腰椎穿刺（等于spinal tap）
短语：puncture needle — 穿刺针
短语：puncture wound — 刺伤，穿刺伤
例句：She was cycling home when she had a puncture .
她骑车回家途中轮胎被扎破了。

glandular
音标：英 /'glændjʊlə; 'glæn(d)ʒʊlə/  美 /'glændʒəlɚ/
adj. 腺的,腺状的
短语：glandular epithelium — [医]腺上皮
例句：...the amount of fat and glandular tissue in the breasts.
...乳房里的脂肪和腺体组织含量。

音标：英 /'glaɪkə(ʊ)saɪd/  美 /'glaɪkə,saɪd/
n. [化]配醣, 配糖类

n. 粗加工的成品

unusable
音标：美 /,ʌn'juzəbl/
adj. 不能用的,与众不同的
例句：Bombing had made roads and railways unusable.
轰炸使得公路和铁路都不能用。

inducible
adj. 可诱导的,可导致的
例句：In addition, plants have also evolved an adaptive inducible resistance mechanism in response to pathogen invasion.
同时，植物还形成了一套适应性更广的可诱导的抗病机制。
例句：Objective To study the expression of inducible nitric oxide synthase in lung carcinoma and its relation with clinical parameters and tumor angiogenesis.
目的：研究人体肺癌组织诱导型一氧化氮合酶的表达及其与临床参数和肿瘤血管生成的关系。
例句：To examine the effect of simulated weightlessness on inducible HSP70 expression in the heart and vessel tissues of rats, a tail suspension rat model was used to simulate weightlessness.
为研究模拟失重是否可引起大鼠心肌与血管组织HSP70的诱导表达发生改变，用尾部悬吊大鼠模型模拟失重，以研究失重对生理的影响。

sepal
音标：英 /'sep(ə)l; 'siːp(ə)l/  美 /'sɛpl/
n. 萼片
例句：Botany The hood-shaped sepal or corolla of some flowers.
盔状花冠（或花萼）：某些花朵盔状的花萼或花冠。
例句：A flower is made up of four parts:the sepal, petal, stamen and pistil.
一朵花由四部分组成：花萼，花瓣，雄蕊和雌蕊。
例句：Leave away the sepal and crash the petal parts. Preheat the oven to 175C/350F.
将干燥玫瑰花去掉花萼，以手捏碎花瓣部份。烤箱预热至175C/350F。

snippet
音标：英 /'snɪpɪt/  美 /'snippit/
n. 小片, 片断
例句：...snippets of popular classical music.
…流行古典音乐的片段。

correlate
音标：英 /'kɒrəleɪt; -rɪ-/  美 /'kɔrəlet/
v. 相互关联
adj. 相互关联的
短语：correlate with — 找出一一对应的关系；使…与…发生关系
例句：Attempts to correlate specific language functions with particular parts of the brain have not advanced very far.
试图把特定的语言功能和大脑特定区域相联系的努力还没有取得很大进展。

beetle
音标：英 /'biːt(ə)l/
n. 甲虫
短语：dung beetle — n. 蜣螂；金龟子科；甲虫
短语：ground beetle — 土鳖虫；步甲，步行虫
短语：bark beetle — 树皮甲虫
例句：He studied the Namib beetle, an ingenious species that lives in one of the driest places on earth.
他研究了纳米布甲虫，这是一种机灵的物种，生活在世界上最干燥的地方之一。
例句：With half an inch of rain per year, the beetle can only survive by consuming the dew it collects on the hydrophilic skin of its back in the early mornings.
它的生活地每年只有半英尺的降雨量，这种甲虫可以通过使用它背部具吸水性的皮肤在早晨收集的水露存活下来。
例句：While other bugs may change color due to external circumstances like temperature, the Panamanian tortoise beetle is one of the few creatures known to control its own color changing.
据了解，其他小虫可能是随着外部环境（如：气温）的变化而变色的，但巴拿马龟甲虫是可以控制自身颜色变化的少数动物之一。

glycoprotein
音标：英 /,glaɪkə(ʊ)'prəʊtiːn/
n. [化]糖蛋白类, 醣蛋白
例句：Straight edge: The miracle fruit (Synsepalum dulcificum), native to West Africa, contains a glycoprotein called miraculin that binds to taste receptors on the tongue and makes sour foods taste sweet.
神秘果：一种原产于西非的水果，内含一种叫神秘果蛋白的糖蛋白。 神秘果蛋白结合在味蕾上以后，吃酸的东西也感到是甜的。
例句：What makes the fruit strange and miraculous, is miraculin (a sugar substitute), which is found in large quantities in the fruit, combined with a glycoprotein.
神秘果之所以奇妙神奇，是因水果中含有大量的神秘果素（代糖），合成一种糖蛋白（变味糖蛋白）。

cardiac
音标：英 /'kɑːdɪæk/  美 /'kɑrdɪæk/
n. 强心剂
adj. 心脏的, (胃的)贲门的
短语：cardiac function — 心功能，心脏功能
短语：cardiac arrest — [医]心搏停止
短语：cardiac surgery — 心脏外科，心外科；心脏手术
短语：cardiac output — 心输出量
短语：cardiac muscle — n. [解]心肌
短语：sudden cardiac death — 心脏性猝死；突然心脏死
短语：cardiac disease — 心脏疾病
短语：cardiac arrhythmia — 心律失常；心律不整；心律紊乱
短语：cardiac catheterization — 心导管；心导管插入术
短语：cardiac valve — 贲门瓣
短语：cardiac cycle — 心动周期
短语：cardiac tamponade — 心压塞；心脏填塞
短语：cardiac pacemaker — 心脏起搏器
短语：cardiac failure — 心力衰竭；心机能不全
短语：cardiac insufficiency — 心机能不全
短语：sudden cardiac arrest — 心脏骤停
短语：cardiac index — 心脏指数
短语：cardiac rhythm — [医]心节律；[医]心搏节律
短语：cardiac glycoside — 强心苷
例句：cardiac surgery
心脏手术

glial
音标：英 /'ɡlaɪəl/  美 /'ɡlaɪə/
adj. 神经胶质的
短语：glial cell — 胶质细胞；神经胶质细胞
例句：The glial tissue is where the largest percentage of brain tumors begin.
胶质组织是绝大多数脑部肿瘤的起源。
例句：Cancerous glial tumors generally spread in the brain the way roots spread from a plant.
恶性胶质瘤通常会像从植物伸展出来的根须一样在脑内扩散。
例句：The aura in migraine has been shown to be caused primarily bycortical spreading depression (CSD), a progression of depolarizationin neurons and glial cells that spreads slowly across the cortex.
偏头痛的先兆主要由皮层传播抑制引起（CSD），CSD是一种在神经元和胶质细胞缓慢穿过皮质的去极化进程。

autonomic
音标：英 /,ɔːtə'nɒmɪk/  美 /,ɔtə'nɑmɪk/
adj. 自治的, 自律的
短语：autonomic nervous system — 植物性神经系统，自主神经系统
短语：autonomic learning — 自主学习
例句：Concepts such as autonomic computing will have a key role in cloud storage architectures in the future.
在未来，诸如自主计算这样的概念将在云存储架构中起到关键的作用。
